consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I am hungry," she said.
corrige: Introducteur au passé → backshift : am → was.
Le pronom « I » devient « she ».
She said (that) she **was** hungry.
exercices.reponse: She said (that) she was hungry.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec say ou tell : He ___ me that he was leaving.
corrige: Il y a un complément de personne (me).
On emploie « told ».
He **told** me that he was leaving.
exercices.reponse: He told me that he was leaving.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I will help you," he said to me.
corrige: will → would ; « you » (moi) devient « me ».
He said he **would** help me. / He told me he would help me.
exercices.reponse: He told me (that) he would help me.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I can drive," she said.
corrige: Le modal « can » devient « could ».
She said (that) she **could** drive.
exercices.reponse: She said she could drive.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "Where do you work?" she asked.
corrige: Question ouverte : on garde le mot interrogatif « where ».
Ordre affirmatif, pas de « do », backshift → worked.
She asked where I **worked**.
exercices.reponse: She asked where I worked.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question fermée : "Are you tired?" he asked.
corrige: Question oui/non → introduite par « if » (ou whether).
Ordre affirmatif + backshift.
He asked **if** I **was** tired.
exercices.reponse: He asked if I was tired.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I have lost my keys," she said.
corrige: present perfect → past perfect (had + participe).
« my » (à elle) devient « her ».
She said she **had lost her** keys.
exercices.reponse: She said she had lost her keys.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I saw him here yesterday," he said.
corrige: saw → had seen ; here → there ; yesterday → the day before.
He said he **had seen** him **there the day before**.
exercices.reponse: He said he had seen him there the day before.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « He asked me where did I live. »
corrige: Dans une question rapportée, on rétablit l'ordre affirmatif.
On supprime « did » et on applique le backshift.
He asked me where I **lived**.
exercices.reponse: He asked me where I lived.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "Do you like coffee?" she asked me.
corrige: Question fermée → « if » ; ordre affirmatif, pas de « do ».
Backshift : like → liked.
She asked me **if** I **liked** coffee.
exercices.reponse: She asked me if I liked coffee.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « said » ou « told » : She ___ that she was busy.
corrige: Il n'y a pas de complément de personne après le verbe.
On emploie donc « said ».
exercices.reponse: She said that she was busy.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec « said » ou « told » : My brother ___ us a funny story.
corrige: « us » est un complément de personne direct.
Seul « tell » accepte ce complément : « told ».
exercices.reponse: My brother told us a funny story.

exercices.enonce: Quel temps devient le présent simple dans le discours rapporté, après « He said… » ?
corrige: Après un introducteur au passé, le temps recule d'un cran.
Le présent simple devient le prétérit (ex. : work → worked).
exercices.reponse: Le prétérit.

exercices.enonce: Donne l'équivalent au discours rapporté de « tomorrow ».
corrige: Le repère de temps s'adapte au point de vue de celui qui rapporte.
« tomorrow » devient « the next day ».
exercices.reponse: the next day

exercices.enonce: Donne l'équivalent au discours rapporté de « here ».
corrige: Le lieu n'est plus celui où l'on parle.
« here » devient « there ».
exercices.reponse: there

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I love my dog," Tom said.
corrige: « I » devient « he » et « my » devient « his » (Tom parle de lui).
Backshift : love → loved.
exercices.reponse: Tom said (that) he loved his dog.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I live in London," Emma said.
corrige: Présent simple → prétérit : live → lived.
« I » devient « she ».
exercices.reponse: Emma said (that) she lived in London.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "We are watching a film," they said.
corrige: Présent en be + -ing → prétérit en be + -ing : are watching → were watching.
« We » devient « they ».
exercices.reponse: They said (that) they were watching a film.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I must go," he said.
corrige: D'après la règle du cours, « must » devient « had to ».
« I » devient « he ».
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he had to go.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I visited Rome," Lucy said.
corrige: Prétérit → past perfect (had + participe passé) : visited → had visited.
« I » devient « she ».
exercices.reponse: Lucy said (that) she had visited Rome.

exercices.enonce: Choisis la phrase correcte : (a) She said me the truth. (b) She told me the truth.
corrige: « me » est un complément de personne : il faut « tell ».
« said me » est incorrect.
exercices.reponse: (b) She told me the truth.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "Is it raining?" Paul asked.
corrige: Question fermée → « if » (ou « whether »).
Ordre affirmatif sujet + verbe et backshift : is → was.
exercices.reponse: Paul asked if (ou whether) it was raining.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "What are you doing?" my mother asked me.
corrige: On garde le mot interrogatif « what ».
Ordre affirmatif (I + was doing), backshift et pas de « ? ».
exercices.reponse: My mother asked me what I was doing.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "You are my best friend," Sarah told me.
corrige: « You » (moi) devient « I » ; « my » (à Sarah) devient « her ».
Backshift : are → was.
exercices.reponse: Sarah told me (that) I was her best friend.

exercices.enonce: Associe chaque mot du discours direct à son équivalent rapporté : now, this, yesterday.
corrige: now → then ; this → that ; yesterday → the day before.
exercices.reponse: now → then ; this → that ; yesterday → the day before

exercices.enonce: Traduis en anglais : « Il a dit qu'il était fatigué. »
corrige: Introducteur : « He said ».
« était » se traduit par le prétérit « was ».
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he was tired.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "Where did you buy this jacket?" Jack asked me.
corrige: On garde « where », on supprime « did » et on rétablit l'ordre affirmatif.
Prétérit → past perfect : I had bought ; « this » devient « that ».
exercices.reponse: Jack asked me where I had bought that jacket.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "Can you help me?" the old man asked us.
corrige: Question fermée → « if ».
can → could ; « you » devient « we » ; « me » devient « him ».
exercices.reponse: The old man asked us if (ou whether) we could help him.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "How old is your sister?" the teacher asked me.
corrige: On garde « how old » et on remet l'ordre sujet + verbe : my sister was.
« your » (à moi) devient « my ».
exercices.reponse: The teacher asked me how old my sister was.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I am leaving today," she said.
corrige: am leaving → was leaving.
« today » devient « that day ».
exercices.reponse: She said (that) she was leaving that day.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I will finish this essay tomorrow," Ben said.
corrige: will → would ; this → that ; tomorrow → the next day.
« I » devient « he ».
exercices.reponse: Ben said (that) he would finish that essay the next day.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "We have never been to Scotland," they said.
corrige: Present perfect → past perfect : have been → had been.
« We » devient « they ».
exercices.reponse: They said (that) they had never been to Scotland.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « She told that she was late. »
corrige: « tell » exige un complément de personne.
On écrit « She told me that… » ou « She said that… ».
exercices.reponse: She said that she was late. (ou : She told me that she was late.)

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « He said he is tired. »
corrige: L'introducteur est au passé : il faut appliquer le backshift.
is → was.
exercices.reponse: He said he was tired.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « She asked if I did like chocolate. »
corrige: Pas d'auxiliaire « do / did » dans une question rapportée.
On écrit simplement le verbe au prétérit : liked.
exercices.reponse: She asked if I liked chocolate.

exercices.enonce: Retrouve les paroles exactes : He said he was hungry.
corrige: On remonte le backshift : was → am.
Le pronom « he » redevient « I ».
exercices.reponse: "I am hungry."

exercices.enonce: Retrouve la question d'origine : She asked me where I lived.
corrige: On remet l'ordre interrogatif avec l'auxiliaire « do ».
lived → live ; « I » redevient « you ».
exercices.reponse: "Where do you live?"

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "Why didn't you call me?" Anna asked her brother.
corrige: On garde « why », ordre affirmatif, plus d'auxiliaire en tête.
Prétérit → past perfect à la forme négative : he hadn't called ; « me » devient « her ».
exercices.reponse: Anna asked her brother why he hadn't called her.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I will lend you my bike," Max told his cousin.
corrige: « I » → he ; « you » → him (le cousin) ; « my » → his.
will → would.
exercices.reponse: Max told his cousin (that) he would lend him his bike.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I met these girls here yesterday," Tom said.
corrige: met → had met ; these → those.
here → there ; yesterday → the day before.
exercices.reponse: Tom said (that) he had met those girls there the day before.

exercices.enonce: Trouve et corrige les deux erreurs : « He said me that he will come. »
corrige: Erreur 1 : « said me » → « told me » (complément de personne).
Erreur 2 : pas de backshift → « will » devient « would ».
exercices.reponse: He told me that he would come.

exercices.enonce: Trouve et corrige l'erreur : « The teacher asked us what were we doing. »
corrige: Dans une question rapportée, l'ordre est affirmatif : sujet puis verbe.
« were we » → « we were ».
exercices.reponse: The teacher asked us what we were doing.

exercices.enonce: Traduis en anglais : « Elle m'a demandé si j'aimais le football. »
corrige: Question fermée rapportée → « if » ; « demander » = « ask ».
aimais → liked (pas de « did »).
exercices.reponse: She asked me if (ou whether) I liked football.

exercices.enonce: Traduis en anglais : « Il m'a dit qu'il viendrait le lendemain. »
corrige: « m'a dit » avec complément de personne → « told me ».
« viendrait » → would come ; « le lendemain » → the next day.
exercices.reponse: He told me (that) he would come the next day.

exercices.enonce: Retrouve les paroles exactes : She said she had seen the film the day before.
corrige: had seen → saw (on remonte d'un cran).
« the day before » redevient « yesterday » ; « she » redevient « I ».
exercices.reponse: "I saw the film yesterday."

exercices.enonce: Rapporte ce dialogue en deux phrases (introducteurs au passé) : Mia: "I am going to the cinema." Leo: "Can I come with you?"
corrige: Phrase 1 : backshift am going → was going, « I » → she.
Phrase 2 : question fermée → « if », can → could, « I » → he, « you » → her.
exercices.reponse: Mia said (that) she was going to the cinema. Leo asked if (ou whether) he could come with her.

exercices.enonce: Repère ce qui a changé entre "I have finished my homework now," et « He said he had finished his homework then. » Nomme les trois transformations.
corrige: Temps : present perfect → past perfect (have finished → had finished).
Pronoms : I → he, my → his.
Repère de temps : now → then.
exercices.reponse: Backshift du temps, changement des pronoms, changement du repère de temps.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte ce message d'un camarade : "I lost my phone yesterday. Have you seen it?" (Introducteurs : He said… / He asked me…)
corrige: Phrase 1 : lost → had lost ; my → his ; yesterday → the day before.
Phrase 2 : question fermée → if ; have seen → had seen ; you → I.
exercices.reponse: He said (that) he had lost his phone the day before. He asked me if (ou whether) I had seen it.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "When will the train leave?" a passenger asked.
corrige: On garde « when », ordre affirmatif : the train would leave.
will → would ; pas de « ? ».
exercices.reponse: A passenger asked when the train would leave.

exercices.enonce: Explique en une phrase pourquoi « She asked where did he work » est incorrect, puis corrige.
corrige: Une question rapportée n'est plus une vraie question : on rétablit l'ordre affirmatif et on supprime l'auxiliaire « did ».
Le verbe se met au prétérit : worked.
exercices.reponse: Il ne faut ni auxiliaire ni ordre interrogatif : She asked where he worked.
